description: Returns the on-chain transfer restriction standard for a token and, when a wallet address is provided, whether that address can receive it. Useful for transfer-control facts only — not legal eligibility.

asset_id.description: UNIALL asset id from find_assets results

chain.description: Blockchain name, e.g. ethereum, base, polygon, solana

wallet_address.description: Optional EVM address to check whether it can receive the token

name: check_transferability

answer.description: Short natural-language summary of the result.

assets.description: Matched assets when applicable (find_assets). Empty or omitted for stats/summary tools.

disclaimer.description: Fixed data-only disclaimer; not investment advice.

facts.description: Sourced scalar facts. Each item has field, value, source_url, source_type, as_of.

title: Check transferability
